base_member_text: [L1114-L1135] (HIGH/false-success) Real variables of unhandled rank (notably rank 1) and unknown real cases fall through without collection but are still marked sg%collected(index)=.true., suppressing future attempts.
audit_member_text: [L1114-L1129,L1135] (HIGH/false collection state) For real rank-1 arrays and unsupported real ranks/types, space_collect_index performs no collection yet still marks sg%collected(index) true, suppressing future attempts.

base_member_text: [L82-L101,L104-L121] (MED/index-validation) index_allocate and index_allocated do not validate index or reject an unknown choice, unlike indextos, so invalid requests can silently no-op or report a scalar-like allocated result.
audit_member_text: [L65-L101,L104-L122] (LOW/inconsistent index validation) index_allocate and index_allocated do not validate index as indextos does, and an invalid index can silently no-op or be reported allocated because the default result is true.
[L78-L101] (LOW/unchecked string contract) index_allocate unconditionally takes choice(1:1), which is invalid for a zero-length actual argument, and silently ignores nonempty unsupported choices.

base_member_text: [L329-L336] (MED/selector-contract) space_distribute_vector treats every selector other than lowercase 'x' as 'y', allowing typos or unsupported selectors to choose the wrong decomposition silently.
audit_member_text: [L306-L365] (LOW/asymmetric API contract) space_distribute_vector treats every xy value other than lowercase 'x' as a y distribution, while space_distribute_block_vector accepts only lowercase 'y' and aborts for all other values.

base_member_text: [L1083-L1101,L1147-L1156] (HIGH/bounds) space_collect_mnem passes chartoindex's -1 failure result to space_collect_index, which indexes sg%collected(index) before the later indextos range check can reject it.
audit_member_text: [L1065-L1087,L1135] (MED/unchecked collection index) space_collect_index uses index directly in sg%collected before indextos can validate it, and space_collect_mnem passes through chartoindex results without checking for an unknown mnemonic.

base_member_text: [L760-L768] (LOW/sentinel-contract) space_who_has returns the undocumented magic value -123 when no computational domain contains a coordinate and emits no diagnostic, leaving callers to infer failure.
audit_member_text: [L745-L770] (LOW/unreported lookup failure) space_who_has returns the undocumented sentinel -123 when a point has no owning computational region and provides no status or diagnostic.

base_member_text: [L1335-L1399] (MED/division-by-zero) Grid-cell inverse areas are formed by unconditional division by computed polygon areas (or metric products) with no local degeneracy/zero-area guard.
audit_member_text: [L1335-L1398] (HIGH/degenerate-cell division) gridprops inverts computed cell areas, and in 1D products of metrics, without rejecting zero-area or repeated-coordinate cells, producing infinite geometric factors.

base_member_text: [L707-L729] (MED/memory-leak) The btype '2' distribution path allocates vectorg on every rank but deallocates it only on xmaster, leaking the pointer allocation on each non-master invocation.

[L980-L1005] (LOW/dead-selector) All four loc cases in space_collect_vector_real8 execute the identical collection and there is no default case, so loc currently has no semantic effect while invalid values silently do nothing.

[L1079-L1092,L1131-L1133] (LOW/instrumentation) The collection end marker logs event_coll_start again, and the already-collected early return skips an end marker entirely, producing unbalanced or mislabeled MPE traces.

[L1186-L1189] (MED/distributed-grid-contract) gridprops labels xzg11/yzg11 as the global grid origin but assigns them from the local array element (1,1), which is not the global origin on non-top/non-left MPI subdomains unless callers prevent local invocation.

audit_member_text: [L440-L521,L578-L588] (MED/subdomain-size contract) The MPI decomposition subtracts fixed two-cell borders and immediately allocates local state without checking that every lm and ln is large enough, so an over-decomposed small grid can produce inverted computational ranges.

[L1175-L1253,L1402-L1419] (MED/minimum-grid bounds) gridprops assumes nx>=1 throughout and requires nx>=2 to define alfaz from an interior point; with nx=1 its two boundary-copy assignments merely circulate an uninitialized orientation.
dispositions.rationale: span-confirmed: For nx=1 the interior alfaz loop is empty and the two boundary assignments copy the undefined second column to the first and back. No earlier assignment to alfaz occurs in gridprops, and the nx input lower bound in params.F90 L150 is advisory rather than strict.

evidence_span.quote:
do j=1,s%ny+1
         do i=2,s%nx
            s%alfaz(i,j)=atan2(s%yz(i+1,j)-s%yz(i-1,j),s%xz(i+1,j)-s%xz(i-1,j))
         enddo
         s%alfaz(1,j)=s%alfaz(2,j)
         s%alfaz(s%nx+1,j)=s%alfaz(s%nx,j)

audit_member_text: [L1453-L1529] (MED/empty computational ranges) ranges_init can produce lower bounds greater than upper bounds for small global or local nx/ny values, with no validation before those ranges are consumed by array sections and reductions.
